import os
import sqlite3
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
from src.api import handle_add, handle_import
from src.repository import initialize, list_contacts
from src.service import import_contacts


class ImportContactsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.connection = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
        initialize(self.connection)
        handle_add(self.connection, {"email": "a@b", "name": "Alice"})
        self.addCleanup(self.connection.close)

    def test_counts_and_normalization(self):
        self.assertEqual(handle_import(self.connection, {"contacts": [
            {"email": " A@B ", "name": " Alice "},
            {"email": " C@D ", "name": " Carol "},
        ]}), {"inserted": 1, "updated": 1})
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.connection), [
            ("a@b", "Alice"), ("c@d", "Carol")])
        self.assertEqual(import_contacts(self.connection, [
            {"email": "a@b", "name": " New name "},
        ]), {"inserted": 0, "updated": 1})
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.connection)[0], ("a@b", "New name"))
        self.assertEqual(handle_import(self.connection, {"contacts": []}),
                         {"inserted": 0, "updated": 0})

    def test_invalid_rows_do_not_write(self):
        invalid_rows = [None, [], "row", {}, {"email": "a@b"},
                        {"email": "a@b", "name": "A", "extra": True}]
        invalid_rows += [{"email": email, "name": "A"} for email in
                         [None, 42, "", "a", "@b", "a@", "a@@b", "a @b", "a@b\tc"]]
        invalid_rows += [{"email": "a@b", "name": name} for name in
                         [None, 42, "", " \t\n"]]
        for row in invalid_rows:
            with self.subTest(row=row):
                statements = []
                self.connection.set_trace_callback(statements.append)
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    import_contacts(self.connection, [
                        {"email": "new@b", "name": "New"}, row])
                self.connection.set_trace_callback(None)
                self.assertEqual(statements, [])
                self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.connection), [("a@b", "Alice")])

    def test_duplicates(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            import_contacts(self.connection, [
                {"email": " A@B ", "name": "Changed"},
                {"email": "a@b", "name": "Duplicate"},
            ])
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.connection), [("a@b", "Alice")])

    def test_malformed_envelopes(self):
        for payload in [None, [], "contacts", {}, {"contacts": None},
                        {"contacts": ()}, {"contacts": {}},
                        {"contacts": [], "extra": 1}]:
            with self.subTest(payload=payload), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                handle_import(self.connection, payload)
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.connection), [("a@b", "Alice")])

    def test_database_failure_rolls_back(self):
        for isolation_level in ["", None]:
            with self.subTest(isolation_level=isolation_level):
                self.connection.isolation_level = isolation_level
                self.connection.execute("""
                    CREATE TRIGGER reject_contact BEFORE INSERT ON contacts
                    WHEN NEW.email = 'fail@b'
                    BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'rejected'); END
                """)
                self.connection.commit()
                with self.assertRaises(sqlite3.DatabaseError):
                    import_contacts(self.connection, [
                        {"email": "a@b", "name": "Changed"},
                        {"email": "new@b", "name": "New"},
                        {"email": "fail@b", "name": "Fail"},
                    ])
                self.assertEqual(list_contacts(self.connection), [("a@b", "Alice")])
                self.assertFalse(self.connection.in_transaction)
                self.connection.execute("DROP TRIGGER reject_contact")
                self.connection.commit()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
